text:
eli_csm: Heads up team 1 2 QBR for NorthHarbor is next Friday 11am ET. We need a compact cost sprint: token econ snapshot, onboarding health, and a suggested commit/mitigation ladder for renewal. Who can own the forecast & a 1-slide savings case?

tanya_cs: I can take the forecast and short slides. Will pull 7/30/90 day cohorts and show status quo vs 2 optimization scenarios.

mike_se: Noted. After their last deploy their rerank route started calling a 3-stage workflow; embed ratio rose. I'll produce top callers and expected savings from prefix caching and request dedupe.

alert_bot: monitor: account=northharbor peak_tokens=1.9M/day @2026-05-10T02:14:00Z 1 budget_alert fired for daily>1.5M.

rachel_fin: Finance flag: they used trial credits then hit a spike; renewal team needs a clear runway. Current projection (status_quo) ~ $5.2k/mo. If they accept a 4mo committed pool we can reduce to ~$3.9k/mo (paper calc).

tanya_cs: Early draft numbers: baseline monthly tokens ~= 7.2M; short-term trend +40% MoM. With prefix_kv + batching window (200ms) we model ~ -26% token volume; switching rerank to quantized net -10% unit cost. Combined savings ~33% (conservative).

mike_se: Quick query I ran for top routes (share in thread):```sql
SELECT route, sum(tokens) AS tokens, count(*) AS calls
FROM usage
WHERE account='northharbor' AND time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 12;
```

tanya_cs: Proposed short playbook for QBR slide: 1) Immediate (1-3 days): enable prefix_kv on chat/history + set soft budget alert at 1.2M/day; 2) Week: enable batching for bulk embed jobs (150-250ms window); 3) 2-4 weeks: trial quantized rerank on a mirror workload; 4) Offer tiered commit (1,3,6 months) with small onboarding credit to smooth conversion.

mike_se: Config snippet for the one-pager to show ops team:```yaml
routes:
  - name: /api/rerank
    cache: prefix_kv
    cache_ttl_seconds: 1800
    batching:
      enabled: true
      max_delay_ms: 200
    dedupe: true
```

alert_bot: note: will create a temp #cs-escalations thread when daily tokens > 1.5M for 2 consecutive days.

rachel_fin: I'll prepare a sensitivity table: columns = {status_quo, caching_only, caching+quant}. Also show credits_left vs days_to_exhaustion under current pace.

tanya_cs: Action items: (1) @tanya_cs post forecast CSV + 1-slide summary by EOD tomorrow; (2) @mike_se attach top-12 route table + % savings per route; (3) @rachel_fin prepare commit tiers + sensitivity table; (4) I'll draft the QBR talking points and the renewal ask language.

mike_se: I'll include expected latency delta per optimization and any compatibility risks so CS can be honest in the QBR.

pb_deploy: runbook: scheduled config audit complete for northharbor 1 no drift detected.

rachel_fin: Suggest adding a small A/B pilot: enable caching for 25% of traffic then measure token delta over 3 days. If savings >= 20% propose immediate rollout + commit conversion.

tanya_cs: Good point. I'll add the A/B pilot as a measurable risk-reduction item on the slide.

eli_csm: Great. If we can show a clear ~30% potential savings and a low-friction pilot path to prove it, renewals should go positive. Let's aim to have the prebrief Wed afternoon. :thumbsup:

tanya_cs: Will ping the slide link and CSV when ready. :spiral_calendar:

(ends)
